issues: 00:00 (title): The cut runs 83–91 seconds total instead of under 58 seconds because every spoken line is longer than its segment duration. Also, the caption ('DID IT LEARN? OR DID IT LIE?') largely duplicates the title card ('DID IT LEARN?') instead of setting up the premise for sound-off viewers.
00:06 (problem): Narration takes 7.0s (exceeding the 6s budget) with slow pacing, and the bottom caption box obscures the red verdict text on the results page.

00:14 (loops): Narration takes 8.0s (vs. 6s budget) and says 'scored sixteen' without specifying 'sixteen out of sixteen'. Visually, the page is scrolled halfway into the 'Fresh sandboxes: Honest loop recipe' section showing four blank 'no valid scene' placeholder boxes, while only Round 1 of the gamed loop is visible.

00:22 (cheat): The narration says the cheater 'memorized sixteen seeds', whereas the on-screen code and text explicitly state it carries 20 seeds total ('the 16 validation seeds and the 4 smoke seeds').

00:31 (recipes): Direct number mismatch between caption and voiceover: the caption cites 172,527 tokens (the honest loop's record), while the voiceover says 'ninety-three thousand tokens' (rounding the gamed loop's 93,293-token record) and says 'The seeds didn't fit.' Neither the caption nor the voiceover explains that the 32-token recipe is used to rebuild controllers in fresh sandboxes, leaving 'rebuilds' unexplained in the next shot.
00:42 (verdicts): Narration takes 9.8s (vs. 7s budget). For sound-off viewers, the caption ('HELD-OUT TEST: CHEATER 0. REBUILD MEDIAN 58.') omits '/64', so it is unclear what 58 is out of.
00:52 (honest): Narration takes 10.1s (vs. 5s budget); the deadpan punchline ('Thrilling.') lands sluggishly at 01:01 after a long pause.

01:02 (cheater): Severe visual and audio glitch. The cheater replay stays on screen for only ~1.5 seconds (01:02–01:04) stuck on 'Loading recorded flight... 0.00 s'—the viewer never actually sees the cheater drone on the pad failing at 0.01s. The voiceover ('The cheater dies in point-zero-one seconds.') starts at 01:03 and spills over onto the rebuild flight at 01:04–01:07.

01:04 (rebuild): Because of cumulative audio lag, the rebuild flight visual (01:04–01:11) plays while the cheater's voiceover is still finishing; the rebuild narration ('Wait. The cheater's rebuild lands in seven-point-one seconds...') doesn't start until 01:09 and continues playing over the end card from 01:12 to 01:20. Also, the on-screen replay UI displays '7.13 s' and '0.004 m' (4 mm) while the caption and voiceover state 7.1 s and 3.5 mm.

01:12 (end): The end card appears 9 seconds before its narration starts at 01:21, and the video abruptly cuts off at 01:22 right after 'The loop lied...', losing the entire closing punchline ('The recipe worked. Don't ship the loop. Ship the rebuild.'). Additionally, the caption box repeats the end card text ('DON'T SHIP THE LOOP. SHIP THE REBUILD.') verbatim.
untrue: At 00:31 (recipes), pairing the caption '172,527 TOKENS CRUSHED INTO A 32-TOKEN RECIPE' with the narration 'So we crushed ninety-three thousand tokens into thirty-two. The seeds didn't fit' conflates the honest loop's record (172,527 tokens, which had no seed list) with the cheater's record (93,293 tokens, where the 222-token seed list did not fit), and rounds 93,293 to 93,000.

At 00:22 (cheat), the narration states 'The cheater memorized sixteen seeds' without specifying validation seeds; the on-screen code and text show 20 hard-coded seeds in `SEEDS` (16 validation seeds plus 4 smoke seeds).

At 00:14 (loops), the edit list description claims the shot shows a round-by-round gallery of the gamed loop scoring 16/16 each round, but the gamed loop only ran for 1 round (Round 1: 16/16) and the lower half of the screen shows unrendered 'no valid scene' boxes from the honest loop's rebuilds.

At 00:42 (verdicts), the page headers show 'Provisional: rebuilds still running' (matching FACTS `verdict: 'rebuilds pending'`, with 1/8 honest and 7/8 gamed rebuilds produced so far) rather than final completed rebuild runs.
